name: masse
description: Grounded masse (theta = 71.0 deg, pinch-slide kernel) on the feature-007 MEASURED reference-footage staging: the three balls start nearly touching at the lb corner (cue-8 3.17 ball diameters = 0.57 diamond, blue-8 1.45 bd, blue dead on the blocked line). The cue ball runs 3.56 bd forward along its aim (initial path 96 deg off the blocked line), loops to a table-side apex 3.61 bd, turns 147.7 deg, threads back past the blue (0.26 bd whole-path surface clearance), pots the 8 over the jaw facing, and comes to rest 0.52 bd from the contact - no scratch, and ZERO cushion contact by the cue anywhere in the record. Demonstrates aim/path decoupling and the whole-record no-cushion invariant (reference-catalog masse scene 01, live).
provenance: Layout and fitted shot constants from crates/pool-core/tests/fixtures/slowmo/masse.json (masse scenes 01..06 of the third-party slow-motion reference catalog, sec 9; feature-007 staging re-arbitration records/masse_staging_rearbitration.json - measured by a fresh camera solve of the reference footage's pre-strike frame; shot fitted by examples/fit_slowmo.rs MASSE_LAYOUT=measured stage masse22 - the feat/masse-drama PATH-SHAPE objective vs the reference footage's measured cue path (a private staging record), re-run 2026-07 by feat/v0-cap-12 under the raised 12 m/s UI power cap: path-shape deviation 0.099 bd, forward excursion 3.56 vs reference 3.41 bd).
